<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 99.2 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Important Notice Regarding the Availability of Materials </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>&#8195;&#8195;APTIV PLC </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:120pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" WIDTH="100%" BORDER="0" STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" ALIGN="center">


<TR>

<TD WIDTH="51%"></TD>

<TD VALIGN="bottom" WIDTH="1%"></TD>
<TD WIDTH="48%"></TD></TR>


<TR STYLE="page-break-inside:avoid ; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:8pt">
<TD VALIGN="bottom" ROWSPAN="3">


<IMG SRC="g51729g47c21.jpg" ALT="LOGO">
</TD>
<TD VALIGN="bottom">&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD VALIGN="top">You are receiving this communication because you hold ordinary shares in Aptiv PLC (&#8220;Aptiv&#8221;). Aptiv has released informational materials regarding its <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off</FONT> of its Electrical
Distribution Systems business (&#8220;Versigent&#8221;) that are now available for your review. These materials consist of the Information Statement, plus any supplements, that Aptiv has prepared in connection with the
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off.</FONT> <B>This notice provides instructions on how to access Aptiv materials for informational purposes only. It is not a form for voting and presents only an overview of the Aptiv materials, which contain
important information and are available, free of charge, on the Internet or by mail. We encourage you to access and review the Aptiv materials on the Internet at </B><B>www.materialnotice.com.</B><B> Aptiv is not asking you for a proxy and you are
asked not to send a proxy. </B>The <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off</FONT> consists of the proposed distribution of 100% of Versigent ordinary shares to holders of Aptiv ordinary shares on a pro rata basis. <B>If you want to receive a paper
copy of the informational materials, you must request one. There is no charge to you for requesting a copy. Please make your request for a copy as instructed on the reverse side of this notice</B>.</TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="page-break-inside:avoid ; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:8pt">
<TD VALIGN="bottom">&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:8pt; font-family:Times New Roman">You may view the materials online at <I>www.materialnotice.com</I><I>
</I>and easily request a paper or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> copy (see reverse side).</P> <P STYLE="font-size:2pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:1pt">&nbsp;</P></TD></TR>
<TR STYLE="page-break-inside:avoid ; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt">
<TD VALIGN="bottom" BGCOLOR="#000000">&nbsp;&nbsp;</TD>
<TD VALIGN="top" BGCOLOR="#000000"><FONT COLOR="#FFFFFF"><B>See the reverse side for instructions on how to access materials.</B></FONT></TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</DIV></Center>
